reason: A media tool that converts SVG logos into animated transparent PNG frames, poster images, and optionally MP4 video using browser rendering and ffmpeg.

summaries.zh: 将 SVG 徽标渲染为透明背景的动画序列帧、静态海报图，并可合成为 MP4 视频。
summaries.en: Renders SVG logos into transparent animation frames and poster images, with optional MP4 synthesis.

capabilities: Accepts SVG markup or an SVG file path
Renders frame images in a browser using Playwright-managed Chromium
Writes transparent PNG frame sequences and poster images
Invokes ffmpeg to synthesize MP4 video output
